1.consolidated_definition: No tener ánimo para nada. Estar malhumorado. “Después del divorcio, Marta quedó que no le olían ni las azucenas.”
1.en_consolidated_definition: Lack of enthusiasm for anything; being in a bad mood. "After the divorce, Marta was so despondent that even lilies didn't smell good to her."
